description: This file contains unit tests for the class MessageCommandAckRequestSetter in the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests the behavior of adding, removing, and filtering acknowledgment request headers within message commands, ensuring correct immutability and proper handling of acknowledgment labels.

classes.name: MessageCommandAckRequestSetterTest
classes.description: Unit tests for MessageCommandAckRequestSetter, verifying correct manipulation of acknowledgment headers in message commands.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the MessageCommandAckRequestSetter class is immutable.

methods.name: tryToApplyNullCommand
methods.description: Verifies that applying a null command throws a NullPointerException.

methods.name: addLiveResponseAckLabelByDefault
methods.description: Tests that a live response acknowledgment label is added by default when applying the setter.

methods.name: removeLiveResponseAckLabelWhenResponseRequiredFalse
methods.description: Ensures that the live response acknowledgment label is removed when the responseRequired flag is set to false.

methods.name: removeLiveResponseAckLabelFromOthersWhenResponseRequiredFalse
methods.description: Checks that other existing acknowledgment labels are preserved while the live response label is removed based on responseRequired being false.

methods.name: filterOutOtherBuiltInDittoAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Verifies that the setter filters out acknowledgment labels other than the live response label.

methods.name: addsLiveResponseAckLabelToAlreadyRequiredAckLabels
methods.description: Tests that applying the setter adds the live response acknowledgment label to headers that already have acknowledgment requests marked as required.

methods.name: notAddingLiveResponseAckLabelToExplicitlyEmptyRequiredAckLabels
methods.description: Ensures that no live response label is added if acknowledgment requests are explicitly empty.
